scope: Local macOS delivery: continuous provisional photographic edits, CPU parallelism and resident GPU common adjustments. Standard/Full remain preview quality; no R0-R4 or SF0-SF10 gate is closed.
implementation: One admitted presentation per lane; intermediate drafts stay visible and the next operation takes the latest request. Exact sampling, before/after and export exclude provisional drafts.
Prepare recipe coefficients once, skip inactive nodes, parallelize independent pixels and blur passes through the common bounded Rayon pool; parallel display conversion.

During interaction edit a selected mip directly without rebuilding a pyramid; up to 1024 pixels CPU and 2048 GPU, bounded by viewport. Resume canonical processing after 120 ms of quiet, with cancellation between stages.
GPU light, RGB white balance, curves, saturation/vibrance and advanced colour operate on the resident linear source from the selected RAW engine, before resampling, without display readback.

Native RAW WB requests are coalesced during dragging; an explicitly provisional RGB bridge provides feedback until the same engine finishes exact native WB. Output proof always requests current native WB.
Thumbnail/histogram work is throttled. The detail status row retains its height when native resolution arrives, preserving full viewport coverage at 1:1.

cpu_reference.scope: Generated linear Rec.2020 input. Worker total includes clone/edit/opacity/pyramid; it excludes RAW, display and input latency. No p95/p99 qualification.

native_interactions.scope: Programmatic drafts in native UI, one gesture per configuration. Distinct source/revision pairs include the pre-gesture baseline. Event-to-draw timing is not physical display or pointer latency. RSS is the sampled sum for bundle processes and can double-count shared pages.

gpu_qualification.scope: Separable WGSL with canonical coefficients and persistent display pipeline, odd sizes, alpha, boundaries, 1:1 and signed linear values up to 1000. GPU timing includes qualification compilation/upload/readback; not an interactive speed claim.

intermediate_findings: A native-resolution arrival changed the status-row height and left about 4% of the 1:1 ROI uncovered. Fixed by keeping the row height stable; viewer regression now requires coverage >= 0.999; the final zoom and large matrices pass.

Two earlier runs timed out waiting for screenshot events despite successful temporal drawing. After restoring an active display and keeping it awake with caffeinate, the unchanged final candidate passed all screenshots and the GUI suite. The environmental cause was not independently proven.
limits: Generated Bayer DNGs at 12, 24 and 45.44 MP; this is not camera colour qualification or a personal-photography campaign.
One M4 Mac, Compatible8, Performance on AC. Windows, other GPUs, device loss under load, other profiles and physical memory pressure are not newly qualified here.
No claim of guaranteed 60 fps, p95/p99 or 100 independent gestures per configuration. The measured update intervals and convergence times are reported per case.
Interactive reduced-scale filtering and native-WB RGB bridging are provisional; the final canonical CPU graph remains the export reference.
Geometry, detail and masks use CPU; GPU implementations, incremental node caches and reusable RAW worker sessions remain future work.
The broader deferred preview/memory campaign, physical footprint enforcement and release signing/notarization remain open.
